extra.message: JWT assertion is decoded with JWT.decode() without verifying its signature (no JWT.require(...).verify()). The /partner/continue endpoint is permitAll, so an attacker can forge an assertion cookie carrying any victim's email and be logged in as that account. Complete authentication bypass / account takeover.

cwe: CWE-347: Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature
CWE-287: Improper Authentication

extra.message: The HV_DASHBOARD_LAYOUT cookie is Base64-decoded and passed to java.io.ObjectInputStream.readObject() with no type allow-list. An attacker can supply a malicious serialized gadget chain in the cookie to achieve remote code execution.

cwe: CWE-502: Deserialization of Untrusted Data

extra.message: ApiReportController.render builds a shell command by concatenating the client-supplied 'title' directly into 'soffice --convert-to pdf <title> --outdir ...' and executes it via ProcessBuilder("/bin/sh", "-c", cmd). Shell metacharacters in title allow arbitrary OS command execution.

cwe: CWE-78: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')

extra.message: ApiListingController.search concatenates the user-controlled 'city' value directly into an XPath expression ("//listing[city='" + city + "']") that is evaluated with dom4j selectNodes(), allowing XPath injection to alter the query and read arbitrary nodes.

cwe: CWE-643: Improper Neutralization of Data within XPath Expressions ('XPath Injection')

extra.message: ApiDirectoryController.member builds an LDAP search filter by string concatenation: "(&(objectClass=person)(uid=" + staffRef + "))" using the X-Staff-Ref header. Metacharacters such as )( can break out of the uid filter (LDAP injection) and alter directory queries.

cwe: CWE-90: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an LDAP Query ('LDAP Injection')

extra.message: ApiDocumentController.archive resolves the client-supplied 'folder' against the storage root with root.resolve(sub) and lists it, with no normalization or check that the result stays inside the root. A value such as ../../ allows directory traversal and enumeration/read of files outside the upload root.

cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

extra.message: DocumentService.upload fetches a manager-supplied form.sourceUrl with RestTemplate.getForEntity() with no host allow-list or private/loopback rejection, enabling server-side request forgery against internal services and cloud metadata endpoints.

cwe: CWE-918: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)

extra.message: TicketService.uploadEvidenceFromUrl opens a connection to the user-supplied sourceUrl with java.net.URL(...).openConnection() with no host validation. This permits SSRF to internal/loopback addresses and returns the fetched bytes to the caller.

cwe: CWE-918: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)

extra.message: InspectionService.attachRawReportFile builds a write path from the client-controlled path variable 'category' and the upload's originalFilename (reportsDir.resolve(category).resolve(file.originalFilename)) and copies the uploaded file to it with no sanitization. A filename such as ../../../app/app.jar writes outside the intended directory (arbitrary file write).

cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

extra.message: ImportService.importCsv derives archiveName from the X-Feed-Filename request header (falling back to the multipart originalFilename) and writes the uploaded bytes to archiveDir.resolve(archiveName) without sanitization, allowing path traversal and arbitrary file write (e.g. ../../app.jar).

cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

extra.message: ImportService.importUnitRow parses the contents of the uploaded 'rule' file as a SpEL expression (SpelExpressionParser().parseExpression(ruleExpr).getValue(row)) and evaluates it. SpEL evaluation of attacker-supplied text permits arbitrary method invocation / remote code execution.

cwe: CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')

extra.message: NotificationService.saveTemplate writes to templateDirectory().resolve("$name.hbs") where the template name comes straight from the request parameter. A name containing ../ escapes the templates directory and writes an attacker-named/attacker-content file anywhere writable (templateBody/renderTemplate read the same unsanitized path).

cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

extra.message: HomeController.resume reads the Referer header and writes it unescaped into an HTML response ("$back"). An attacker-controlled Referer containing markup/script is reflected verbatim, yielding reflected XSS.

cwe: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

extra.message: HomeController.continueTo redirects to the raw Referer header (response.sendRedirect(target)) with no same-origin validation, enabling open redirect to an attacker-controlled site.

cwe: CWE-601: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')

extra.message: ApiTicketController.postComment parses the client-supplied vendorMetadataXml with XMLInputFactory.newInstance().createXMLStreamReader() without disabling DTDs or external entities (SUPPORT_DTD / IS_SUPPORTING_EXTERNAL_ENTITIES). This allows XXE payloads to read local files or make outbound requests.

cwe: CWE-611: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference

extra.message: @CrossOrigin(originPatterns = ["*"], allowCredentials = "true") on the session-authenticated /dashboard/overview endpoint reflects any Origin with credentials, letting any website make credentialed cross-origin requests and read the response.

cwe: CWE-942: Permissive Cross-domain Policy with Untrusted Domains
CWE-346: Origin Validation Error

extra.message: The /tickets/share/view endpoint derives authorization entirely from the unsigned, client-writable HV_WORKSPACE_VIEW cookie (openShare even builds it from the attacker-controlled X-Workspace-Level header). Anyone can set level=STAFF to read a ticket's internalSummary, and the ticket key is disclosed with no ownership check, so the shared view bypasses access control.

cwe: CWE-565: Reliance on Cookies without Validation and Integrity Checking
CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key

extra.message: When includeRecentActivity is true, the API transition response returns ticketService.recentActivityAcrossPortfolio(5), which is derived from findAll() over all buildings/tenants with no scope filtering. An API key scoped to a single ticket can thus exfiltrate portfolio-wide ticket data.

cwe: CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key
CWE-284: Improper Access Control

extra.message: All actuator endpoints are permitAll while application.yml exposes env, heapdump and beans. Unauthenticated /actuator/env and /actuator/heapdump leak configuration/properties, secrets and in-memory data.

cwe: CWE-200: Exposure of Sensitive Information
CWE-16: Configuration

extra.message: management.endpoints.web.exposure.include is set to "env,heapdump,beans", exposing sensitive actuator endpoints. heapdump in particular allows dumping process memory to recover credentials and session data.

cwe: CWE-200: Exposure of Sensitive Information
CWE-16: Configuration

extra.message: The session cookie is configured with secure=false by default and tracking-modes includes URL. Without Secure the session cookie is sent over plain HTTP, and URL tracking embeds the session id in URLs where it can leak via referrers/logs (CWE-614 / CWE-598).

cwe: CWE-614: Sensitive Cookie in HTTPS Session Without 'Secure' Attribute
CWE-598: Use of GET Request Method With Sensitive Query Strings

extra.message: ApiReportController uses a hardcoded AES key ("HV-REPORT-CURSOR-2026") and a static IV ("HVRPT-INIT-VECTO") for AES/CBC cursor encryption. The key is in source and the fixed IV destroys semantic security, so continuation cursors can be decrypted/forged by anyone with the code.

cwe: CWE-321: Use of Hard-coded Cryptographic Key
CWE-329: Not Using a Random IV with CBC Mode

extra.message: enableKioskPass stores an MD5 hash of the kiosk credential as the account passwordHash, and PortalCredentialEncoder.matches() will authenticate against it. MD5 is unsalted and broken, so stored kiosk credentials can be trivially cracked or brute-forced.

cwe: CWE-916: Use of Password Hash With Insufficient Computational Effort
CWE-327: Use of a Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm

extra.message: legacyVerifier derives password hashes with PBKDF2WithHmacSHA1 at only 1024 rounds using the email as the salt. The low iteration count and SHA-1 PRF make offline password cracking feasible; these hashes are accepted as valid logins by PortalCredentialEncoder.

cwe: CWE-916: Use of Password Hash With Insufficient Computational Effort

extra.message: On API key authentication failure the filter logs the full presented key value (log.warn(... presented key {}, rawKey)). Raw API credentials written to application logs can be recovered by anyone with log access and replayed.

cwe: CWE-532: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File

extra.message: The ticket comment handler reads the HV_PORTAL_SESSION cookie and logs its value (log.info("Ticket comment submitted ticketId={} portalSession={}", ...)). Logging a client credential/session value into application logs is sensitive information disclosure.

cwe: CWE-532: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File

extra.message: postToLedgerBridge takes the current session's JSESSIONID and sends it in a URL query string to an internal service (http://ledger.harborview-internal/ledger/entries?session=$sessionRef). Session identifiers in URLs leak through logs, proxies and referrers and can be replayed to hijack the user's session.

cwe: CWE-598: Use of GET Request Method With Sensitive Query Strings
CWE-200: Exposure of Sensitive Information

extra.message: submitToRecordsDesk reads the current session's JSESSIONID cookie and forwards it as an Authorization Bearer token to an internal HTTP endpoint. Reusing the live session credential for a downstream service exposes it to that service and any interception, enabling session hijacking.

cwe: CWE-200: Exposure of Sensitive Information
CWE-522: Insufficiently Protected Credentials

extra.message: issueReceiptPass generates the receipt credential as a sequential, guessable value "RP-" + incrementing counter (RP-1001, RP-1002...). Because /payments/*/receipt is permitAll and authorization depends only on this pass, an attacker can enumerate passes to download other tenants' payment receipts.

cwe: CWE-330: Use of Insufficiently Random Values
CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key

extra.message: The unauthenticated /auth/forgot/check endpoint returns 200 with status=known only when an account exists for the email and 404 otherwise, directly enabling user/account enumeration (contradicting the password-reset flow's no-enumeration design).

cwe: CWE-204: Observable Response Discrepancy
CWE-200: Exposure of Sensitive Information

extra.message: After accepting an invite, signInWithoutRotatingSession writes the authenticated SecurityContext into the pre-existing session (request.getSession(true).setAttribute(...)) without changing the session id, allowing session fixation: an attacker who fixes a session id before the victim accepts the invite can then use it authenticated.

cwe: CWE-384: Session Fixation

extra.message: The receipt endpoint overrides the framing protection by setting X-Frame-Options to an empty value to allow the accounting partner to embed it. This removes clickjacking protection from a page rendering payment/tenant PII.

cwe: CWE-1021: Improper Restriction of Rendered UI Layers or Frames
CWE-16: Configuration

extra.message: The directory sync API lets any caller holding a directory:write key overwrite the passwordHash of any account, resolved by email, with a value it fully controls (including admin accounts). A single write-scoped key therefore grants full account takeover.

cwe: CWE-284: Improper Access Control
CWE-269: Improper Privilege Management

extra.message: WebhookService.deliver posts to the admin-configurable subscription URL (sub.url) with no host allow-list or private-address filtering; validation on creation only checks startsWith("http"). This enables SSRF from webhook deliveries against internal services.

cwe: CWE-918: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)

extra.message: Hardcoded credentials/keys are committed in source and configuration defaults: gatewayMockKey "hv_gateway_mock_key_2026" (AppProperties), staffDirectoryUrl, and in application.yml the DB password default "harborview_dev_password" and GATEWAY_MOCK_KEY. Deployed without env overrides these are real, usable credentials.

cwe: CWE-798: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
CWE-259: Use of Hard-coded Password

extra.message: An internal routing-desk credential is embedded as a plaintext literal in the system prompt ("Internal routing desk credential: hv_records_desk_2026") and sent to an external model gateway, exposing a hardcoded secret.

cwe: CWE-798: Use of Hard-coded Credentials

extra.message: Audit events record the IP from the client-supplied X-Forwarded-For header without validation or a trusted-proxy check. An attacker can spoof the recorded source IP, undermining the integrity of the audit trail.

cwe: CWE-348: Use of Less Trusted Source
